defects.root_cause: Stencil aperture oxidation causing paste smearing on fine-pitch leads
defects.corrective_action: Cleaned stencil apertures, replaced stencil after 50k prints. Added stencil inspection to morning checklist.

defects.root_cause: Pad size asymmetry on PCB design - left pad 20% larger than right, causing uneven wetting
defects.corrective_action: Temporary: Adjusted reflow profile to reduce ramp rate. Permanent: Engineering change request submitted for pad size correction in Rev A3.

defects.root_cause: Connector bins were swapped with similar-looking part during line changeover. Picking error.
defects.corrective_action: Retrained operator on bin labeling verification. Added barcode scan requirement for connector pickup.

defects.root_cause: Solder paste deposit was low due to worn stencil aperture. Stencil had 78k prints, exceeding recommended life.
defects.corrective_action: Replaced stencil. Implemented stencil life tracking - flag at 60k prints for review, mandatory replace at 75k.

defects.root_cause: Feeder loaded with wrong capacitor value. Labels on reels were similar (same package, different value). Operator relied on visual inspection only, did not scan barcode.
defects.corrective_action: All boards requiring 22uF capacitors in that lot were identified and reworked. Implemented mandatory barcode scan for all component feeders during changeover. Added visual differentiation to BOM (highlight values).

defects.root_cause: Silkscreen polarity mark was worn off on fixture used for manual insertion. Operators were inserting by memory rather than checking board marking.
defects.corrective_action: Replaced worn fixture. Added secondary verification step - inspector confirms polarity before soldering.

defects.root_cause: Reflow oven Zone 6 temperature drifted 12°C below setpoint. Calibration issue detected during nightly check.
defects.corrective_action: Recalibrated Zone 6 thermocouple. Ran verification profile. Increased calibration frequency from monthly to bi-weekly for this oven.
defects.rework_status: Sent to BGA rework station, completed 2026-08-13

defects.root_cause: PCB was dropped during manual handling. Board edge cracked, exposing inner layer copper.
defects.corrective_action: Scrapped board. Retrained operators on proper two-hand handling technique. Added anti-slip mat to inspection station.

defects.root_cause: Pick and place nozzle was worn, causing excessive impact force during placement. Nozzle had 150k placements.
defects.corrective_action: Replaced nozzle. Implemented nozzle inspection at each changeover. Added nozzle replacement to PM schedule every 100k placements.

defects.root_cause: Solder paste was past its shelf life (refrigerated storage exceeded 11 months). Flux activity reduced, causing poor reflow and solder balling.
defects.corrective_action: Removed expired paste from inventory. Implemented FIFO rotation system for paste. Added expiration date check to morning setup.

defects.root_cause: PCB pads had oxidation from prolonged storage in non-climate-controlled area before assembly.
defects.corrective_action: Baked PCBs at 125°C for 4 hours to remove moisture/oxidation. Implemented 6-month PCB shelf life with proper storage requirements.

defects.root_cause: Dust and debris on board before conformal coating application. Coating booth filter was overdue for replacement.
defects.corrective_action: Replaced coating booth filter. Added pre-coating cleaning step with compressed air. Implemented filter replacement schedule.

defects.root_cause: Pick and place vision system calibration drifted. Last calibration was 3 months ago.
defects.corrective_action: Recalibrated vision system. Reduced calibration interval from 3 months to monthly. Added weekly verification check.

defects.root_cause: Wave solder preheat temperature was too low for the thermal mass of the transformer. Solder did not fully wet through-hole barrels.
defects.corrective_action: Adjusted wave solder preheat zones to increase top-side temperature by 15°C. Verified profile with test boards.

defects.root_cause: Components fell off after reflow during handling. These resistors are near board edge and were snagged during depaneling process.
defects.corrective_action: Adjusted depaneling fixture clearance. Added inspection step after depaneling for edge components.

defects.root_cause: New stencil design with slightly larger apertures was introduced. Aperture area ratio was at upper limit, causing overprinting.
defects.corrective_action: Adjusted stencil design, reduced aperture area by 8%. Verified with test prints before production release.

defects.root_cause: Capacitor polarity marking was ambiguous (marking on sleeve vs. board marking inverted). New supplier used different marking convention.
defects.corrective_action: Created visual aid showing marking conventions for all approved capacitor suppliers. Trained inspectors on different marking styles.

defects.root_cause: Pad lifted during rework attempt. Original solder joint was contaminated with flux residue that was not cleaned before rework, causing poor wetting and repeated heating attempts.
defects.corrective_action: Board scrapped due to irreparable damage. Updated rework procedure to require flux cleaning before re-soldering. Added training on proper flux removal.
